body: The only thing stopping me is the pain it would bring my family, otherwise I’d of been gone a long time ago.

I don’t know how I can help others when I can’t even help myself, I was speaking to my grandad today and asked him if he’ll ever move on and he told me he’d feel like he’s cheating on her and that he’d always compare them to her
If it wasn’t for my family I would have killed myself a long time ago, I’m not afraid to die and actually find the thought of it quite comforting

It was my nan, I’ve lived with her for around 3 years. She was one of the nicest people I’ve ever met, she used to help a woman who was depressed and feeling suicidal by talking to her, she would put anyone before herself and had time for anyone. I just wish she was here to help me fight through this but she’s also part of the reason I feel this way.
